scope: Ramses DLMM on Robinhood Chain (chainId 4663), complete indexed history plus exact on-chain replay

forbidden_inputs: existing 35-bps hurdle as a qualification gate
permitted_inputs: complete historical indexed swaps and fee events

split.holdout_rule: never inspect holdout outcome metrics until one candidate rule is frozen from derivation+validation

indexed_stage.purpose: nominate repeatable historical regimes; indexed outcomes alone cannot establish profitability
indexed_stage.anti_concentration: rank both position-weighted and equal-pool-weighted; cap one pool at 10 nominated windows per rule per split

exact_replay_stage.entry_state: archive-RPC state at the frozen entry block before outcome
exact_replay_stage.range_state: all proposed bins plus every economically mutated bin required for exact terminal equality
exact_replay_stage.fee_capture: paper share of authenticated per-bin LP fees
exact_replay_stage.inventory_pnl: full withdrawal inventory plus executable same-pool residual unwind at exit block
exact_replay_stage.sizing: fraction of exact local range liquidity, never total factory TVL
exact_replay_stage.costs: use historical/verifiable Ramses lifecycle gas when available; otherwise publish both pre-gas and conservative cost-sensitivity results and do not call a marginal result profitable

criteria: median after-cost return > 0 in validation and holdout
mean after-cost return > 0 in validation and holdout
profitable observation rate > 0.55 in validation and holdout
positive result supported by at least 3 pools in validation and holdout, unless explicitly labeled pool-specific
result remains positive under conservative execution-cost sensitivity
